sections.p: Every day you get missions from the areas you chose. How many, and how long they run, follows the time you said you have: with 15 minutes, one; with 30 or 45, two that fit in about that time; with an hour or more, three, or four with Push me. They're picked to fit your answers, what you're working toward and this week's focus. A day runs from 4:00 AM to 3:59 AM, so a late night counts as the day it started.

Don't want one? Swap it before you prove it, and you get another mission from the same area when one fits today. One swap a day, three with UNSETLD+. A swap after the day's first earns at most what the mission it replaces was worth, so more swaps never mean more points. A mission you swap stays away for a week, or three weeks after you swap it a third time in a month; one you swap because you can't do it today can come back tomorrow. An everyday habit like Study One Subject for 30 Minutes or Complete Your Workout comes back after a couple of days.

Do the mission for real, then prove it in the app. Each mission says how: a photo, a photo before and after, the focus timer and then a photo, or the timer on its own. Photos are taken with the camera in the app in the last 30 minutes, and a photo can only count once.
The checks run on this phone. They look at when and how the photo was taken and whether the timer ran to the end, never at what's in a photo. Nobody reviews your photos and no AI looks at them.
Each proven mission earns the points shown on it, once. Longer missions earn more. Points come only from proven missions.
list: Perfect day, every mission proven: 15 more.

sections.p: Your streak is the days in a row you proved at least one mission. Today counts once you prove one. Until then, yesterday's streak stands.

Your streak counts the days you showed up. Completion counts how much of those days you finished: missions proven out of missions planned, on the days you proved at least one. Stats shows it for this week and, once your record goes back far enough, the last 30 days. A day with every mission proven is a perfect day.
Miss a day and an Off Day covers it, so the streak keeps going. You earn one every 7 days you show up. You can bank two.

Each mission's points also count as XP for its area, so you can see where the work is going. An area levels up as its XP adds up, and XP is never spent. Achievements mark your first mission, your first perfect day, 7 days, your first finished Plan, 30 missions and more.

A Plan, like 7 Day Lock In, sets missions for a run of days. While one runs, all of the day's Plan missions are in your list, even when they take longer than the time you chose, and your other missions fill what time is left. A Plan day moves on once you prove one of its missions, so a missed day doesn't end it. A finished Plan stays on your record. Finishing one earns no extra points.

Photos stay on this phone. They're deleted from it after 30 days, the next time the app opens, unless you choose 1 year or Always under Proof photos in You. The mission, its points and your streak stay.

Points trade for discount codes at unsetld.com, each for one order. Taking one spends its points. What's on offer, what each one costs and its limits can change with each collection: Rewards shows what's open now, and All rewards shows each one with its limits.

Status is separate from points: it counts the days you prove at least one mission, and spending points never lowers it. Each status tier is one discount code for one order at unsetld.com, yours once you reach its number of days. Status, in Rewards, shows the tiers on offer, how far you are from each and the codes you've taken.

One code per order. Codes don't combine with other codes, including the first-order code. Each reward's own limits, such as how many you can take each collection, the most it takes off or a minimum order, are shown with it in All rewards, and a status tier's are on its page. Each status code can be taken once.
Points and status come only from proven missions. UNSETLD+ doesn't change them, and none of it is for sale.
To use a reward or UNSETLD status you need a free account, made with Sign in with Apple, so unsetld.com can hold your place. Your photos stay on this phone.
For US residents 13 and over. If you're under 18, get a parent's or guardian's OK before you place an order.
Points and status are earned only by proving missions in the app. They can't be bought, and UNSETLD+ doesn't change them.

Each mission proven in the app earns the points shown on it once, from 5 to 20 depending on how long it takes, and 15 more when every mission in the day is proven. Proof must be your own: a photo of that mission taken with the camera in the app, or, for a timer mission, the in-app timer run to the end. Points from earlier versions of the app carry over. We may remove points earned through misuse, such as proof that isn't of the mission.

Points can be traded for the discount codes shown in the app, each for one order at unsetld.com. The rewards on offer, the points each one costs, their dates and their limits (how many you can take each collection, the most a code takes off, any minimum order and how long a code works) are shown in the app and may change with each collection. Codes are single use and only valid at unsetld.com.

Status counts the days you prove at least one mission. Each status tier gives one discount code for one order at unsetld.com, once per person, when you reach its number of those days. Taking it doesn't spend points. The tiers on offer, the days each one needs, its discount, the most it takes off and how long its code works are shown in the app and may change with each collection.
No cash value. Not transferable. Points, codes and status can't be sold, bought or exchanged for money. One code per order. Codes don't combine with other codes, including the first-order code.
We may change or end rewards and UNSETLD status with 30 days' notice in the app. Points already earned can still be traded for 30 days after they end.
unsetldclothing@gmail.com

UNSETLD gives you daily missions, a camera to prove them, points, a streak, levels, plans and reminders. It isn't medical, financial or professional advice. Do missions within your limits, and swap any that don't suit you.
UNSETLD is for people 13 and over.

Your goal, a weekly focus you type and missions you write are checked on this phone, by fixed rules. Some things can't be used, such as fasting, nicotine, alcohol or drugs, betting, dares or private details like passwords and card numbers, and the app says so under the field. If what you write is about hurting yourself, the app shows where to get free, confidential help.

UNSETLD+ is sold through Apple as an auto-renewing subscription (yearly or monthly) or a one-time lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase, or when a free trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Settings, your name, Subscriptions. Any unused part of a free trial ends when you buy a subscription.
Apple's Licensed Application End User License Agreement (apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula) also applies.
Rewards and UNSETLD status have their own terms, under Help in You and at the end of How points work.
The missions and everything else in the app are original to UNSETLD. Your proof photos are yours and stay on your phone.
unsetldclothing@gmail.com
Your missions, your answers, your streak, points and proof photos live on your iPhone. There are no ads, no tracking and no analytics SDKs, and the app doesn't collect data about how you use it.

Purchases: Apple processes payments, and RevenueCat (our subscription provider) receives an anonymous app user ID and your purchase history so UNSETLD+ works across your devices. Time check: the app asks unsetld.com for the current time so streaks stay honest. No identifier is sent. Config: the app reads small public files from unsetld.com to know whether rewards are on, which rewards and status tiers are offered and when drops open. Nothing else leaves your phone unless you sign in, below.

The camera is used only when you prove a mission. The app keeps one copy of each photo, inside the app on this iPhone, and never uploads it: the camera's full-size original and the copy made while resizing are deleted once it's kept, and a photo you took but didn't use is deleted later, when the app starts. Each photo is re-encoded when it's saved, which removes its metadata, including location. Photos are deleted after 30 days, the next time the app opens, unless you choose 1 year or Always under Proof photos in You; the mission and its points stay. Like other app files, they can be part of your own iPhone backup.

Proof is checked on this phone: that a timer ran to the end, and that the photos were taken just now, in the right order and after the timer, and weren't used before. The checks don't look at what's in a photo. There is no facial recognition, no AI and no one reviewing your photos.
Missions never ask for photos of your face or body, other people, IDs, addresses, bank details, grades, medical information or private conversations, or for your location. There is no public feed.

The areas you chose, the time you have each day (and how hard you want it, with an hour or more), what you're working toward and the area you pick for it, this week's focus, what you're learning and your age range decide which missions and options you get. Answers an earlier version of the app asked, such as whether you're in school, stay on this phone and can still shape your missions. What you type (your goal, a focus of your own, missions you write) is checked for unsafe words on this phone, never sent anywhere. All of it stays on your phone.

UNSETLD is for people 13 and over. When you start, the app asks the year you were born, and the month only when it's needed to tell whether you're 13 yet. Only an age range is kept (13 to 15, 16 to 17, or 18 and over), on this phone; the year and month aren't saved or sent. On iOS 26 and later, where Apple says age rules apply, the app may ask Apple for your age range instead. Apple shares only the range, and if it isn't shared, the app asks for the year. If the answer is under 13, the app deletes everything it saved on this phone, the Keychain copy included, and goes no further. We don't knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 13. If you think a child under 13 has signed in, email us and we'll delete the account.

sections.h: If you sign in for rewards or UNSETLD status
sections.p: Signing in with Apple is optional and only needed to use rewards and UNSETLD status. We receive an Apple user ID and, if you choose, a private relay email. We store the days you proved a mission and each day's number of proven missions and points (dates and numbers only, never photos) so we can hold your place and issue single-use codes. We also keep a token from Apple so we can end the Sign in with Apple link when you delete your account. Nothing else.

Mission reminders are off until you turn them on. Reminders, the focus timer alert and, during a free trial, a reminder the day before it ends are local notifications scheduled on your phone. Drop alerts are separate, off by default, and only on if you turn them on.
Links to unsetld.com open in Safari, which is covered by that site's privacy policy.

So a reinstall picks up where you left off, the app keeps a copy of your record in this iPhone's Keychain: the days on your record; each proven mission with its title as you saw it (words from your goal and missions you wrote included), its points, when it was proven and what the proof checks found; where its photos are saved on this phone and their fingerprints, never the photos; Plans finished; reward codes you've taken; tasks and answers from earlier versions; and a random number the app uses to vary your missions. The app never uploads it. iOS can keep it after the app is deleted, and it can be part of your own encrypted iPhone backup. If you sign in, the sign-in token is kept in the Keychain too.

To delete everything UNSETLD keeps on this iPhone, open You, then Delete data on this phone. It removes your record, points, plans, answers, settings, missions you wrote, proof photos, sign-in on this phone and the Keychain copy, and clears the app's reminders and widgets. During a free trial, the reminder before it ends stays. It doesn't delete an account on unsetld.com, and UNSETLD+ stays with your Apple ID. Deleting the app removes its data too, except what the app keeps in the Keychain, which iOS can keep; use Delete data on this phone first if you don't want a reinstall to bring your record back. Copies already in an iPhone backup stay in that backup.

To delete an account, open You, then Account, then Delete account. We remove the account and what we hold for it, and end the Sign in with Apple link. It doesn't delete what's on this phone: Delete data on this phone does that. You can also email unsetldclothing@gmail.com from the address on the account.

Apple keeps its own record of what you buy. RevenueCat keeps the purchase history it holds under an anonymous ID. To have that deleted, email unsetldclothing@gmail.com with the order ID from Apple's receipt, and we'll ask RevenueCat to delete it.
unsetldclothing@gmail.com
